integrity: The included standalone verifier uses exact integers and checks all 4094 frequency characters for n=2..12; infinite statement is proved by algebraic identities and induction.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary Motzkin excursions and adjacent UD pairs only; no claim for arbitrary colored or other paths, nor for endpoint norms. Historical source covers all-marked univariate peak count; novelty restricted to spatially arbitrary Fourier signs and sharp stability. Bounded priority risk remains.
title: Strict Fourier positivity and sharp stability of Motzkin sharp-peak profiles
